entries.question: Mujhe yeh jaankaari chahiye ki KJMU mein Ultrasound whole abdomen ka karwana ho toh uski timing kya hai aur kya yeh inshulk hai?
entries.answer:

ORS website (ors.gov.in) ya Health Care App ke through aap appointment book kar sakte hain. SMS dwara booking ke liye, `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` likh kar 8887019134 par bhejein. Ultrasound whole abdomen ke liye koi alag se "inshulk" (chalan/fee) ka zikr nahi hai, lekin OPD slip ki fee ₹50 lagoo hogi. Aapko yeh bhi pata hona chahiye ki pahaadi ilaakon ke mareezon ko referral lana hoga aur pehle booking karwana sujhaav diya jaata hai. Parchi counter dopahar 1:00 baje band ho jaata hai.

Agar aapko aur jaankari chahiye toh aap KGMU helpline number 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333 par sampark kar sakte hain.

*   **Registration:** Online registration is mandatory.
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).

*   **Referral:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department.

entries.question: vaccination for babies
entries.answer:
Vaccination is one of the most important things you can do to protect your baby's health. Vaccines help your baby’s immune system recognize and fight dangerous diseases before they become serious.

### **Why are baby vaccinations important?**
*   **Protection:** They provide immunity against diseases that can be life-threatening for infants (like Whooping Cough, Polio, and Measles).
*   **Community Immunity:** By vaccinating your baby, you also help protect vulnerable people in your community who cannot be vaccinated (such as newborns or those with weakened immune systems).
*   **Safety:** Vaccines are rigorously tested for safety and effectiveness before being approved for use.

### **Typical Vaccination Schedule**
While schedules vary slightly by country, most health organizations (like the CDC or WHO) recommend vaccines starting shortly after birth. In the first year, babies typically receive doses at:
*   **Birth:** Hepatitis B

*   Redness, swelling, or soreness at the injection site.
*   A mild fever.
*   Increased fussiness or sleepiness.

**What you can do:**
*   **Comfort:** Hold and cuddle your baby after the shot to soothe them.
*   **Hydration:** Offer plenty of breastmilk or formula.

Agar maut ka karan bilkul spasht hai aur kisi natural disease ( Prakritik bimari) ke karan hui hai, jaise ki heart attack ya kidney failure, aur koi apradhik ya shankaaspad paristithi nahi hai, to post-mortem hamesha zaroori nahi hota. Lekin, final decision KGMU ke doctors aur kai baar police department dwara liya jata hai.

entries.question: Kidney and lever se effect hone se death ho jaye usme PM ka kya
entries.answer:
Agar kisi ki maut kidney aur liver ki bimariyon ke karan hoti hai, to post-mortem (PM) zaroori hai ya nahi, yeh kuch baaton par nirbhar karta hai:

1.  **Disease Ka Puraana Ya Achanak Hona:** Agar patient lambe samay se kidney aur liver ki bimariyon se pidit tha aur maut usi bimari ke natural progression ( prakritik vikaas) ke karan hui hai, to PM hamesha zaroori nahi hota. Lekin agar maut achanak ho gayi ho, ya maut ka karan bilkul spasht na ho, tab PM kiya ja sakta hai.
2.  **Shanka Ya Apradhik Gatividhi:** Agar maut ke karan par koi shanka ho, jaise ki kisi zeher ka asar (poisoning), ya koi apradhik gatividhi ka sandeh ho, toh PM zaroori hai. Aise cases mein, forensic expert maut ka karan pata lagane mein madad karte hain.
3.  **Police Ki Request:** Agar police ko kisi bhi karan se maut ke karan ki jaanch karni ho, to PM mandatory ho sakta hai, bhale hi maut kidney aur liver ki bimari se hui ho.
4.  **Medical Records Ki Uplabdhata:** Agar patient ke medical records spasht roop se darshate hain ki maut ka karan kidney aur liver ki bimari hi thi aur koi anya karan nahi hai, to PM ko chhod diya ja sakta hai. Lekin agar koi ambiguity (sandeh) ho, toh PM kiya ja sakta hai.

**Aam taur par:** Agar maut kisi lambi chal rahi bimari (jaise ki chronic kidney disease ya cirrhosis) ke natural course mein hui hai aur koi suspicious circumstance nahi hai, toh PM nahi kiya jata. Lekin, agar maut ke karan mein koi bhi shanka, achanak ghatna, ya police involvement ho, to PM kiya jayega, chahe woh kidney aur liver ki bimari se sambandhit ho.

*   **Legacy & Experience:** KGMU is one of the oldest and most prestigious medical universities in India. Its long history translates into a very strong alumni network and established academic traditions.
*   **Clinical Exposure:** Being a massive tertiary care center with a very high patient load, the clinical exposure at KGMU is among the best in the country. You will encounter a vast spectrum of cases, which is vital for medical training.
*   **Campus Life:** It is a large, historic campus located in the heart of Lucknow. The sheer size and diversity of the student body provide a very vibrant campus life.

*   **Brand Value:** The "AIIMS" tag carries significant national prestige and is recognized globally. AIIMS institutions generally receive high priority in terms of central government funding and infrastructure development.
*   **Modern Infrastructure:** As a relatively new institute, AIIMS Bathinda features state-of-the-art, modern infrastructure, new laboratories, and updated medical technology.

*   **Student-to-Patient Ratio:** Being a newer institute, the patient load is growing but is currently lower than that of a legacy institution like KGMU. This can sometimes allow for more personalized attention from faculty during clinical rotations.

| Feature | KGMU Lucknow | AIIMS Bathinda |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Establishment** | Very Old (Legacy) | New (Modern) |
| **Patient Load** | Extremely High | Moderate/Growing |
| **Infrastructure** | Mix of Historic & Modern | Modern/State-of-the-art |
| **Brand** | Premier State University | National Importance (AIIMS) |

*   **Choose KGMU if:** You prioritize massive clinical exposure, a large and active campus life, a massive alumni base, and want to study in a historic institution with a proven track record of producing top-tier doctors.
*   **Choose AIIMS Bathinda if:** You prefer modern infrastructure, the "AIIMS" brand name, a potentially more structured research-oriented environment, and the advantages of a newer, central-government-funded institution.

    *   **ABHA/Health Care App:** इसके माध्यम से भी आप अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं।
    *   **SMS सेवा:** `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` लिखकर **8887019134** पर भेजें।

2.  **वॉक-इन (Walk-in):**
    *   अस्पताल आकर पंजीकरण कराने के लिए अपना **आधार कार्ड** और **सक्रिय मोबाइल नंबर** साथ लाएं।
    *   मोबाइल पर प्राप्त OTP के माध्यम से टोकन प्राप्त करें।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
*   **पंजीकरण शुल्क:** ₹50 (सभी माध्यमों के लिए)।
*   **समय:** पंजीकरण काउंटर दोपहर 1:00 बजे बंद हो जाते हैं।
*   **रेफरल:** यदि आप लखनऊ के बाहर से आ रहे हैं, तो संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल पत्र (Referral Slip) साथ लाना अनिवार्य है।
*   **परामर्श:** भीड़ से बचने के लिए प्री-बुकिंग (Online) की सलाह दी जाती है।

अधिक जानकारी के लिए आप KGMU की वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) देख सकते हैं। 

*चेतावनी: मैं एक AI हूँ, कृपया अपनी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य जानकारी या आधार नंबर जैसी संवेदनशील जानकारी यहाँ साझा न करें।*

entries.answer:
KGMU mein patient ka appointment lene ke liye online registration mandatory hai. Aap niche diye gaye tarikon mein se kisi ek ka upyog kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Appointment (ORS/Health Care App):**
*   Website: [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jayein.
*   'Uttar Pradesh' select karein, phir 'KGMU' chunein.
*   'New Appointment' par click karke department aur date select karein.
*   Patient ki details bharein aur ₹50 ka shulk (fee) online jama karke slip download kar lein.

**2. SMS dwara:**
*   Aap `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain.

**3. Walk-in (Hospital aakar):**
*   Aap direct hospital aakar bhi registration kara sakte hain. Iske liye aapke paas Aadhaar card aur ek chalu mobile number hona chahiye.
*   OTP verify hone ke baad ₹50 ka token lekar OPD slip prapt karein.

**Dhyan dein:**
*   OPD ka samay: Somvar se Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   Parchi/ticket counter 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai.
*   Agar aap Lucknow se bahar ke hain, toh sambhandhit department ka valid referral letter sath zarur layein.

Kripya chat mein patient ki koi bhi sensitive jankari (jaise Aadhaar number ya phone number) share na karein.
